geo_headlines: Second round of US-Iran strikes overnight. Iran state media reports three killed in western Iran. US likely to re-impose Iran naval blockade per reports. Iran chief negotiator states Strait of Hormuz opens only under 'Iranian arrangements' — direct commercial-shipping threat (NYT, AP News, Hindu, Fox)

Brent crude broke $80 overnight — up 9% for the week. WTI $74.49 (+1.32% overnight, +5% on week). Third consecutive session higher. Ground News flags this as Wells Fargo's confirmed 'geopolitical risk premium is back' regime (Reuters, Ground News)

FOMC Minutes released Wed 14:00 confirmed hawkish tilt: 9 of 18 officials see at least one hike by year-end (6 see two), 8 see no change, only 1 sees a cut. Chair Warsh submitted NO dot-plot projection — first Fed chair to withhold since 2012. 'Family fight' language. Dropped 'easing bias'. Staff revised core PCE up 0.6pp in single quarter (2.7% -> 3.3%) while trimming GDP. Bank of America now sees THREE hikes before year-end (GoldSilver, CNBC, NYT, Fortune, WSJ)
Asia chip complex rebounded on NVDA H200 China-sale rumor: Kospi opened +3%, SK Hynix +7.5%, Samsung +3.6%. Nikkei briefly +1,600 pts. First up session in three for the region

US Wed 7/8 close: Dow -1.1% (-576.76 pts) on Industrials/Materials weakness, SPX -0.28% to 7,482.71, Nasdaq +0.2% (semis SOX +2.2% rebound). Broadcom led chip rally. Split-market day: geopolitics + Fed hawkishness beat cyclicals while chip narrative held (Reuters, PMR, CNBC)

FedWatch cohort 7/8 extended hawkish repricing: Sep cum-hike 69% (from 63% Tue), Oct 77%, Dec 86%. Bear-flattener continues. BofA raised forecast to 3 hikes before year-end but sees hiking cycle brief
